ok.meaning: Whether the update route and both binaries are present.

routePresent.meaning: Whether the local_ai_update_now Harmonia route resolves.

installed.meaning: Whether both llama binaries are files.

receiptPresent.meaning: Whether the selected runtime receipt can be read.

receiptOk.meaning: Whether the readable receipt has boolean ok true.

receiptPath.meaning: Configured runtime receipt path, or the default receipt path.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed runtime or HTTP gate outcome token; none means the route and both binaries are present.
